title: Plans under Healthier SG for Younger Persons with Disabilities
what_it_is: Plans under Healthier SG for Younger Persons with Disabilities

sections.label: Care for intellectual disabilities
sections.summary: MOH offers a Family Practice Skills Course and pilots a Community Integrated Health Team for persons with intellectual disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As part of the Master Plan, MOH has collaborated with the College of Family Physicians Singapore to offer a Family Practice Skills Course for general practitioners, which equips them in caring for persons with intellectual disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are also piloting a Community Integrated Health Team in partnership with a social service agency and a specialist outreach team from the Institute of Mental Health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These multidisciplinary teams offer home- or community-based care for persons with intellectual disabilities who have complex health needs.

sections.label: Inclusive sports and activity guidelines
sections.summary: The Singapore Physical Activity Guidelines were updated in 2022 to include PwDs, and SportSG expanded Para Sports Academy opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, the Singapore Physical Activity Guidelines, developed by the Health Promotion Board and SportSG, were updated in 2022 and expanded to be inclusive of PwDs, providing recommendations and tips for PwDs to stay active.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: SportSG has expanded sporting opportunities for PwDs through the Para Sports Academy programme and is also working with the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth to update the Disability Sports Masterplan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH and the Ministry of Social and Family Development will continue to study the gaps in service provision for PwDs and explore how to work with healthcare providers and community partners to strengthen support for them.
